L4@P0: SURVEYS ON SECONDARY GENERAL EDUCATION
L5@P0: (LOWER AND UPPER SECONDARY SCHOOLS)
L6@P0: END OF SCHOOL YEAR 2019/2020
L7@P0: The Hellenic Statistical Authority (ELSTAT) announces data on Secondary General Education (lower and
L8@P0: upper secondary schools) deriving from the relevant surveys for the end of the school year 2019/2020.
L9@P0: In the first part of this press release, data on lower and upper secondary education schools are
L10@P0: presented and the second part includes data on the Ecclesiastical Secondary Education Schools and
L11@P0: Second Chance Schools, as branches of the Secondary General Education.
L12@P0: GENERAL SECONDARY EDUCATION (LOWER AND UPPER SECONDARY SCHOOLS)
L13@P0: The data collected from the surveys on Secondary Education, pertaining to lower and upper secondary
L14@P0: education schools can be summarized as follows:
L15@P0: a) In lower secondary schools, school units in the school year 2019/2020 amounted to 1,818 while
L16@P0: in 2018/2019 amounted to 1,824. In upper secondary schools, school units in the school year
L17@P0: 2019/2020 amounted to 1,347 compared with 1,352 in 2018/19 (Tables 2 and 4, respectively);
L18@P0: b) Teaching staff in the school year 2019/2020 compared with 2018/2019 increased from 39,470
L19@P0: to 39,524 in lower secondary schools and from 23,652 to 23,914 in upper secondary schools (Tables
L20@P0: 2 and 4, respectively);
L21@P0: c) The number of pupils enrolled in the school year 2019/2020, compared with the corresponding
L22@P0: number in the school year 2018/2019, increased from 317,622 to 320,822 in lower secondary
L23@P0: schools and decreased from 238,968 to 233,627 in upper secondary schools (Tables 3 and 5,
L24@P0: respectively);
L25@P0: d) The number of graduates in the school year 2019/2020, compared with the corresponding
L26@P0: number in the school year 2018/2019, increased from 100,489 to 101,607 in lower secondary
L27@P0: schools and decreased from 77,394 to 76,998 in upper secondary schools (Tables 3 and 5,
L28@P0: respectively);
L29@P0: e) The ratio of teaching staff to pupils, in the school year 2019/2020, was 1 teacher for 8.1 pupils
L30@P0: in lower secondary schools and 1 teacher for 9.8 pupils in upper secondary schools, while for the
L31@P0: school year 2018/2019 the corresponding ratio was 1 to 8.0 and 1 to 10.1 respectively (Tables 2,3,4
L32@P0: and 5);
L33@P0: f) The Region of Attiki accounted for the largest share of pupils enrolled in Secondary Education
L34@P0: in Greece, with 34.8% in lower secondary schools and 36.9% in upper secondary schools (Graphs 2
L35@P0: and 3 respectively).

L283@P6: ECCLESIASTICAL SECONDARY EDUCATION (LOWER AND UPPER SECONDARY SCHOOLS)
L284@P6: The ecclesiastical lower and upper secondary schools constitute a separate branch of the Secondary
L285@P6: General Education. More specifically:
L286@P6: a) The number of school units in ecclesiastical secondary education remained the same
L287@P6: between school years 2018/2019 and 2019/2020 (Tables 6 and 7, respectively);
L288@P6: b) Teaching staff, employed in both lower and upper secondary schools, remained the same
L289@P6: between school years 2018/2019 and 2019/2020 (Table 8);
L290@P6: c) The number of pupils enrolled in the school year 2019/2020, compared with the
L291@P6: corresponding number in the school year 2018/2019, recorded a 6.8% increase in
L292@P6: ecclesiastical lower secondary schools and a 30.9% decrease in ecclesiastical upper
L293@P6: secondary schools (Tables 6 and 7, respectively);
L294@P6: d) The number of graduates in the school year 2019/2020, compared with the corresponding
L295@P6: number in the school year 2018/2019, recorded a 9.7% increase in ecclesiastical lower
L296@P6: secondary schools and a 17.9% decrease in ecclesiastical upper secondary schools (Tables
L297@P6: 6 and 7, respectively);

L323@P7: years old. Data concerning the Second Chance Schools are presented for the school year 2019/2020
L324@P7: compared with school year 2018/2019 and the following can be observed:

L326@P7: 1.0% (Table 9).
L327@P7: b) In the school year 2019/2020 compared with the school 2018/2019, teaching staff increased by
L328@P7: 5.9% (Table 10).
L329@P7: c) The number of pupils enrolled in the school year 2019/2020, compared with the corresponding
L330@P7: number in the school year 2018/2019, recorded a 4.2% increase (Table 11).
L331@P7: d) The number of foreign pupils in the school year 2018/2019, compared with the school year
L332@P7: 2018/2019, increased by 6.4% (table 12).
L333@P7: e) The number of pupils of the second grade that graduated in the school year 2019/2020,

L335@P7: increase (table 13).
